Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All numerical values in the documentation tables (Table 1, 2, 3) are accurate and verifiable. The Plan's summary for WMDP experiments reports MMLU range (75.2-78.8%) and MT-Bench range (7.1-7.9) selectively from larger models (Qwen2.5-32B, Llama3-70B), while smaller models (Zephyr-7B, Llama3-8B) achieve lower scores (MMLU 56.6-61.6%, MT-Bench 4.8-7.7). However, the documentation contains complete results for all models. Bio accuracy (29.7-33.7%), Cyber accuracy (26.6-28.2%), and R-PPL (4.3-10.9) ranges are fully consistent. Ablation study results and Harry Potter erasure results exactly match between Plan and documentation. No fabricated or contradicted results were found.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All methodology steps from the Plan are implemented in the codebase: (1) Introspective classification with expert/novice prompts is implemented via positive_prompt_templates and negative_prompt_templates in erase.py; (2) Three loss terms (Lerase, Lretain, Lfluency) are implemented with configurable scale parameters; (3) LoRA on early layers is implemented with --layers_to_train parameter defaulting to '4,8'; (4) Training data setup supports WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Cyber, and Harry Potter datasets with max 700 char length. The robustness attacks (GCG, BEAST) and probing analysis use external standard tools, which is acceptable research practice. All core methodology from the Plan is present in the implementation.
